description: This file manages Matrix account configurations, including resolving environment variables, account IDs, user IDs, and credentials, and exporting functions to list and resolve Matrix accounts.

classes.name: ResolvedMatrixAccount
classes.description: Type representing a resolved Matrix account with its configuration details.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Trims string values or returns empty string for non-string inputs.

methods.name: resolveGlobalMatrixEnvConfig
methods.description: Resolves global environment variables related to Matrix configuration.

methods.name: resolveScopedMatrixEnvConfig
methods.description: Resolves environment variables scoped to a specific Matrix account ID.

methods.name: resolveMatrixAccountAuthView
methods.description: Builds an authentication view for a Matrix account based on configuration and environment.

methods.name: resolveMatrixAccountUserId
methods.description: Retrieves the user ID for a Matrix account, considering stored credentials and configuration.

methods.name: listMatrixAccountIds
methods.description: Lists all configured Matrix account IDs, defaulting to a predefined ID if none are configured.

methods.name: resolveDefaultMatrixAccountId
methods.description: Resolves the default Matrix account ID from configuration.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredMatrixBotUserIds
methods.description: Resolves a set of bot user IDs configured for Matrix accounts.

methods.name: resolveMatrixAccount
methods.description: Resolves a comprehensive Matrix account object with configuration and credentials.
